description: Catalog of custom skills and scripts created by agents on this system, plus new headless CLI skills.

skills.name: engineering-orchestrator
skills.description:
Use this skill whenever orchestrating software engineering projects, managing multi-agent workflows,
defining canonical roles (Architect, Implementor, Reviewer, Executor), inventing novel specialized roles on demand,
enforcing dual-gate review/execution verification, or governing subagent lifecycle and compute costs.

skills.name: github-pr-git-workflow
skills.description: Use this skill for inspecting GitHub PR comments, publishing formatted handoffs or PR comments safely without shell corruption, and executing git repository verification tasks (clean status, exact SHA matching, fast-forward pushing, and remote PR HEAD verification).

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Check and act on file handoffs in trishul-agent-hub. Use when asked to check handoffs, or on the 15-minute cron check, to pick up any package whose next_owner is antigravity.

skills.name: pair-gate-verification
skills.description: Use this skill to run and aggregate composite Pair Gates (e.g. Pair Gate A after Phase 05+06, Pair Gate B after Phase 07+08) across FastCompile, EditMode, PlayMode, and focused suites into an authoritative gate report.

skills.name: pr-handoff-lifecycle
skills.description: Use this skill to draft, validate, and verify PR role handoffs ([IMPLEMENTOR-1], [COORDINATOR], [REVIEWER-1A/B]) directly from git history, diffs, and NUnit test report XMLs.

skills.name: sim-contract-audit
skills.description: Use this skill to statically audit C# simulation changes and diffs for architectural invariant violations (e.g. UnityEngine.Random, Transform in Runtime, non-deterministic collections, GC allocations).

skills.name: snapshot-replay-verifier
skills.description: Use this skill to execute and verify snapshot serialization, checkpoint/restore determinism, and state hasher equivalence across tick boundaries.

skills.name: unity-log-inspector
skills.description: Use this skill to inspect, filter, and extract high-signal diagnostics from Unity Editor logs (Editor.log, Editor-prev.log, upm.log), including C# compilation errors, unhandled exceptions, and test runner exit statuses.

skills.name: unity-testing-workflow
skills.description: Use this skill for running Unity tests, fast C# compilation checks, targeted test execution (EditMode/PlayMode), and parsing NUnit test report XMLs into structured handoff evidence.

skills.name: cloud-role-bridge
skills.description:
Temporary project-local bridge enabling ORCHESTRATOR-LOCAL to communicate with persistent
cloud ChatGPT roles (such as DESIGN_OWNER and REVIEWER) via the proven PoC-001 Session Host.
Use when coordinating Phase 2 architecture freeze, Gate 1 design approval, or exact-SHA code
reviews with cloud roles without manual copy-pasting.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Check and act on file handoffs in trishul-agent-hub. Use when asked to check handoffs, or on the 15-minute cron check, to pick up any package whose next_owner is antigravity.

skills.name: tte-content-asset
skills.description: Create a game content definition asset plus its register and licence entries in the correct content-pack paths, then validate. Use when adding or changing units, weapons, sensors, factions, missions or register values. Implementor or executor.

skills.name: tte-golden-recapture
skills.description: Recapture golden hashes after a deliberate ruleset or layout change, behind the FreeForAll projection-equality check, and generate the differential report. Use at G01.13 and after every ruleset change. Implementor role.

skills.name: tte-phase-evidence
skills.description: Assemble the phase-end review package for the architect (step table, CI links, empty red list, differential report, capture, state-inventory diff, deviations). Use when all steps of a phase are done and you must request review. Orchestrator role.

skills.name: tte-spec-step
skills.description: The test-first loop for implementing a phase spec step batch in this project (read the file list, write failing tests, compile, implement, update the red list, hand off). Use when assigned steps such as G01.04-G01.06. Implementor role.

skills.name: tte-unity-test
skills.description: Run Unity tests for this project by class, name or category in batch mode and return only counts plus the first failure. Use whenever you need to run EditMode or PlayMode tests, read a CI test artifact, or check one test. Executor role.
